title: Saudi Dumplings
description: A traditional Saudi dish with dumplings flavored with nutty spices. This recipe makes a delicious and satisfying meal.
instructions: Boil water in a large pot and add dumplings.
Cook for 10-15 minutes or until dumplings float.
While dumplings are cooking, prepare the flaky pastry by rolling it out thinly.
Cut the pastry into small squares, about 3 inches per side.
Place a dumpling in the center of each square.
Fold the pastry squares over the dumplings to form triangles, pressing edges to seal.
Fry the dumplings in a pan with a little oil until crispy and golden brown.
Serve warm with your favorite dipping sauce.
